questions.explain: PID amplifies everything from the gyro, including noise. A clean spectrum comes first.

options: A rollback after the stick stops
A delay of the entry after the stick
questions.explain: It is measured as the peak of the opposite sign within 150 ms after the stop / the maneuver amplitude.

questions.q: Why is the median over the maneuvers used for the metrics, not the mean?
options: An outlier does not spoil the estimate
The mean is not available in Blackbox Explorer
questions.explain: The median is robust to outliers.

questions.q: In the case the SHARP profile gave an entry lag 7 ms shorter. At what price?
options: Loss of link at the edge of range
questions.explain: Raising P raises the gain at all frequencies, including the residual noise.

questions.q: Why did the WASH profile (more D) not reduce propwash on a 1.4 kg 7"?
options: Not enough throttle to act on D
questions.explain: The numbers: an RMS of 0.97 of the control — within the measurement noise.

questions.q: How was sharpness finally restored without more noise?
options: The RPM filter was removed for the sake of phase
questions.explain: The CRISP profile: gyro multiplier 1.10, notch Q 450 — the same PID, less phase delay.

questions.q: Two “identical” drones gave a different bounce-back. The lesson?
options: Compare within one series of flights
The metric is broken and unfit for comparison
questions.explain: Compare profiles within one series of flights (one pilot, one program, one charge window) or normalize by the amplitude: the pilot flew more sharply on one of them — D max had time to kick in.

questions.q: How many changes are allowed per tuning flight?
questions.explain: Otherwise the log cannot be interpreted.

questions.q: A bounce-back of 20% on a 5" is:
options: Normal for a 7" on large props

questions.q: The pilot complains of “shake” in hover. What does this fragment of the grader output say?
questions.fragment:
[PASS] tracking roll tracking error: 0.12 (limit <= 0.25)
[FAIL] tracking roll rate with centred sticks: 14.6 (limit <= 6.0 deg/s)
[FAIL] tracking pitch rate with centred sticks: 14.1 (limit <= 6.0 deg/s)
[PASS] filters  roll noise after filters: 2.1
options: Tracking and noise are within limits, but movement remains in hover — the loop is marginal; check P relative to D
Motor noise gets through the filters and rocks the aircraft — the gyro LPF frequencies need to be lowered
The motors saturate in hover, so the loop has no headroom left for stabilization
There is no eRPM telemetry, so the RPM filter is off, and the shake in hover comes from motor harmonics
questions.explain: Tracking and noise are within limits, but movement remains in hover — a sign of the loop oscillating, not of noise.
